hooks.command: in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/gate-prefilter.mjs && exit 0; printf '%s' "$in" | "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/node_modules/.bin/tsx "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/cli.ts dev gate --hook claude-code || { rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 2 ] && exit 2; echo "orca gate: hook failed (exit $rc) — blocked" >&2; exit 2; }
"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/node_modules/.bin/tsx "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/cli.ts dev level --hook claude-code || { rc=$?; echo "orca level: no reading — hook command failed (exit $rc)" >&2; exit 2; }
